items.followUp: Define melting point and state two factors that affect it.

rubric.why: Defines boiling point by the condition at which boiling occurs.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a liquid boils when its vapour pressure equals the external or atmospheric pressure.

rubric.why: States how external pressure affects the boiling point.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that increasing external pressure raises the boiling point, or that decreasing it lowers the boiling point.

accept: non volatile impurities raise boiling point
rubric.why: Identifies the effect of dissolved non-volatile impurities.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that dissolved non-volatile impurities raise the boiling point.

accept: stronger intermolecular forces higher boiling point
stronger intermolecular attraction higher boiling point
rubric.why: Connects stronger attractions between particles with a higher boiling point.
rubric.description: Effect of the nature of the liquid
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that stronger intermolecular forces or attractions result in a higher boiling point.

modelAnswer: The boiling point is the temperature at which the vapour pressure of a liquid becomes equal to the external (atmospheric) pressure.
Increasing the external pressure raises the boiling point; decreasing it lowers the boiling point.
Dissolved non-volatile impurities generally raise the boiling point.
A liquid with stronger intermolecular forces has a higher boiling point.

items.followUp: What is corrosion? Describe two ways to protect iron from rusting.

accept: iron reacts with oxygen and moisture
iron reacts with oxygen and water
rubric.why: Identifies rusting as the formation of hydrated iron oxide through reaction with oxygen and moisture.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming hydrated iron oxide as rust, or describing iron reacting with oxygen and moisture.

rubric.why: Names a coating that prevents air and moisture from reaching the metal.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming painting, oiling or greasing.

rubric.why: Names protection by coating iron with zinc.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that iron can be galvanized or coated with zinc.

rubric.description: Electroplating or another protective metal coating
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming electroplating or a suitable protective coating such as tin or chromium.

rubric.why: Recognizes that making a corrosion-resistant alloy helps prevent rusting.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that alloying iron, for example to make stainless steel, helps prevent rusting.

modelAnswer: Rusting is the corrosion of iron in the presence of oxygen and moisture, forming hydrated iron oxide.
Metals can be protected from corrosion by painting, oiling or greasing their surfaces.
Iron can be galvanized by coating it with zinc.
It can also be protected by electroplating it with a metal such as tin or chromium.
Alloying iron to make stainless steel also helps prevent rusting.

items.followUp: State four characteristics of a colloidal solution.

rubric.why: Identifies the non-uniform nature of a suspension.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a suspension is a heterogeneous mixture.

rubric.why: Describes the relatively large particles of a suspension.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that suspension particles are relatively large or can be seen, usually with a microscope.

rubric.why: Identifies the settling of suspended particles when left undisturbed.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the particles settle when the suspension is left standing.

accept: particles can be separated by filtration
rubric.why: Identifies filtration as a way to separate suspended particles from the liquid.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the suspended particles can be separated by filtration.

modelAnswer: A suspension is a heterogeneous mixture.
Its particles are relatively large and can be seen, usually with a microscope.
The particles settle down when the suspension is left standing.
The suspended particles can be separated from the liquid by filtration.

rubric.how: Award 1 mark for giving the complete configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶.
